issues.description: Method name mismatch for the static supply-delivery API: the problem statement UML and the template Main expect a static method named acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int) on class SealSaloon (UML at problem_statement.md line shows +acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int): void; Main calls shop.acceptSupplyDelivery("Bacon", 50, 100);), but the solution implementation provides a static method named receiveDelivery(String, int, int) in SealSaloon. This inconsistency in the identifier (method name) means example code or tests that call acceptSupplyDelivery will fail to compile or run against the solution class and confuses students about the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across all artifacts. Rename the solution's SealSaloon.receiveDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) to SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) (keeping it static and preserving behavior), and update any references accordingly. Alternatively, if the intended name is receiveDelivery, update the UML in problem_statement.md and the example call in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to use receiveDelivery to match the solution. Ensure Main, the UML, and the reference implementation use the same method name and signature.

issues.description: The exercise asks for a static method named acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int) to update the shared stock, and the example Main calls SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery(...). However, the solution implementation defines a static method named receiveDelivery(String, int, int) in SealSaloon. Concept: accepting a supply delivery to add/update StockIngredient in the shared stock. Problem statement identifier: acceptSupplyDelivery. Template/example identifier: acceptSupplyDelivery (called in Main). Solution identifier: receiveDelivery. This mismatch prevents a direct mapping from the problem and example code to the provided implementation and will confuse students which name to implement or call (and can break example code or tests that expect acceptSupplyDelivery).
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single consistent identifier for the delivery operation. Rename the solution method receiveDelivery to acceptSupplyDelivery with signature public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity), or add a public static acceptSupplyDelivery wrapper that delegates to receiveDelivery. Also ensure the problem examples (Main) and documentation reference the same method name.
